_comment: Which of the GAME's own sprites stands for which phase of «Гонка вооружений» (#2579).
The key is the phase's own kind id as the server states it (`event_id`); the value is
the client's file name, extracted by tools/extract_arms_icons.py into
results/arms_icons/ (git-ignored — the art never leaves the machine that owns the
game). A phase that is not named here draws no picture at all, which is the honest
answer: a wrong icon is worse than none.
THE DRONE PHASE (120004) IS DELIBERATELY ABSENT. The event's own art folder holds six
pictures and four of them are unmistakable — the hero portrait, the base building, the
soldier and the research globe. The remaining two (a mech, a garage) could be the
drone's or could be a season's own phase, and a picture that is probably right is the
one thing this map may not hold.
